programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Katherine-as-Elena joins Matt on a bench at college. She checks his current vervane status and, after he reminds her he doesn't take it in case anyone needs his blood, she plucks off his vervane bracelet. She fills him in on the fact she's now Traveler Katherine, hitching a ride in Elena's body. She wants a crash course in all things Elena. When he objects, Nadia joins them and they compel him for the Elena 411, including fashion choices."My final question, because I'm going to need it... later, is: how did Elena Gilbert break up with you?" she asks.Earlier That Day Nadia tells her mot her that Mia the Traveler says they need her corpse. Until then, Katherine agrees to be chained to the hotel bed in case Elena's consciousness pops through. Damon keeps leaving Elena messages. Nadia goes to find Katherine's body.Back at the Salvatore's, Damon comes in with a dirt-covered shovel. He says he's been "out." He buried Katherine's body. Nadia is there to get it, ostensibly to take it back to Bulgaria, but Damon is only too happy to deny her dying request.At his house, Tyler is starting his day off by drinking. Matt sees he in a funk and, after Tyler won't talk about New Orleans except to say the drama is over, announces he's throwing Tyler a welcome back party.In her dorm room, Caroline works out her issues with obsessive cleaning. Aaron comes by the room to talk to Elena. He tells Caroline Wes won't be a problem anymore -- is family's trust money came through and he cut off all Augustine experiments.When he returns to his room, one of those experiments is waiting -- Enzo is there.Stefan calls Caroline because he thinks Elena is ignoring Damon's calls. Caroline doesn't want any part of getting them back together. "How would you like to be judged solely based on who you're attracted to?" Stefan asks. Caroline thinks of her roll in the woods with Klaus. "Why? Do you know something?"Stefan thinks Elena is good for Damon because she makes him happy. They realize Elena told both of them she was at the other place.Locked to the bed in the hotel room, Elena's phone ringing annoys Katherine. Katherine starts to get the vapors and her eyes go black -- Elena comes to and finds herself chained to the bed. She immediately knows Katherine is behind it.With her vampire strength, Elena is able to break her chains. She rushes for her phone, but before she gets anywhere, Nadia comes back. She calls Katherine back, but they know it's a matter of time until Elena breaks through again.At the bar, Stefan tells Damon he's being a dick pouting over Elena. Caroline arrives, reporting that no one knows where Elena is, but she's there to help Damon get her back"This is what it's come to? You brought me love advice from prudy Trudy?" Damon asks Stefan. "I can be unpredictable, and incredibly reckless," Caroline insists.Damon wanders off, saying he doesn't need their help.In the hotel room, Katherine suggests she go to Tyler's party to assuage everyone's suspicions about Elena and maybe find out where her body is buried. Nadia doesn't like the idea, pointing out that Katherine doesn't know anything about Elena. But Katherine knows just who to go to.Tyler and Matt get ready for the party at the Lockwood mansion. Tyler asks is Caroline is coming but won't admit to wanting her back.Damon comes home to find Enzo waiting for him on his couch with a body bag at his feet and blood on his lips.Enzo knows about Damon systematically killing off the Whitmores and is willing to reconsider his opinion of Damon. He brought Damon a present- Aaron Whitmore."So do you want to kill him? Or shall I?" Enzo asks.At Tyler's party, Elena compels Matt to leave her alone and she finds Stefan. She tells Stefan she was "thinking, processing, trying to figure out this whole Damon thing." Katherine lays on the Elena sweetness thickly.She asks how he's handling Katherine's death then gets annoyed that he's fine. She is pushy suggesting they should have a funeral. She asks where Katherine is buried. Damon said she's where she was always meant to be.Back at the house, Enzo is getting itchy to kill Aaron. Damon struggles not to.Caroline calls Damon to tell him Elena is at Tyler's.Aaron wakes up and Enzo is ready to pounce, but Damon snaps Enzo's neck instead. He takes off Aaron's vervane watch and compels him to leave town.At Tyler's, Katherine tells Nadia that for 145 years, Damon thought she was buried in the tomb under the old church, so that must be where he buried her. Katherine prepares to leave, but back inside she runs into Caroline.Caroline tells Elena "I did a bad thing." Katherine is ready to blow her off, but Caroline insists. Caroline confesses to her Klaus tryst.Katherine is surprised, then when she sees Tyler within earshot, she asks for details. She makes a point of repeating "now that you've slept with Klaus" for Tyler's benefit. Tyler shoots Caroline the death stare of a thousand daggers.Katherine and Nadia join Mia and Katherine's body in the tomb. Mia needs some of Elena's blood, then she digs a knife into Katherine's dead body and recites a spell. Katherine's spirit temporarily leaves Elena's body and Elena plays it calm, realizing very quickly what's going on, and pretends to be Katherine. (So, if you're scoring at home, it's Elena in Elena's body pretending to be Katherine in Elena's body as she stands over Katherine's body.)Back at the Lockwood mansion, Caroline tries to talk to Tyler, but he's focused on the thousands of people that Klaus killed, including his mother.Tyler yells at her to leave, and when she tries to stay to talk to him, he hybrids out at her. Stefan comes to intervene and Tyler throws the Klaus news at him.After taking a moment to process it, Stefan decks Tyler, saying Caroline doesn't deserve to be treated that way.In the tomb, Nadia asks Elena where she wants to start their world tour. Mia the Traveler says she only needs a few more seconds to finish, so Elena shoves her into some rocks, knocking her out. Then she skewers Nadia with a torch.Damon arrives at Matt's but can't get in because he's not invited.Down in the tomb, Nadia wakes up and removes the skewer from her body. Mia is back on her feet, too, and resumes the spell.Out in the woods, Elena triest o call for help but finds there's a pin lock on her phone. She tries to run but Katherine works her way into her head as she runs.Mai continues chanting over Katherine's burning body as Elena loses more and more of herself.Elena reaches the edge of the party and runs into Damon's arms. She gets as far as "Damon, thank god," then Mia announces it's done.Elena's eyes gloss over black again and she seems to be Katherine again. Damon wants to talk and tells her she's the best person he's ever met and for him to assume that he could change her gives him way too much credit and her not nearly enough. "You're the best influence on me, I need you. You're the good and I need a little good in my life. Without it that's an awful lot of darkness," he says.Elena/Katherine tells him that's a lot of responsibility and she can't change who he is. She mentions him torturing Katherine as she lay dying and he's completely confused. She tells him they're over.She turns and walks away, smirking.Stefan hears it and Damon thinks he's enjoying it.Matt finds Tyler sulking and drinking on the couch, trying to figure out how to deal with the fact the girl he love just slept with his nemesis.Tyler tells Matt that Klaus "crushed" him in New Orleans and this comes just when he thought he couldn't do anything worse.In the tomb, Mia covers Katherine's burned body and tells her that Katherien has permanent control of Elena's body. Mia asks about her payment. Katherine rips out her heart from behind, saying she hates loose ends."She gave me the creeps anyway," Nadia says. "Cold, manipulative, good hair -- you really are my daughter," Katherine says.Nadia's ready to hit the road, but Katherine announces she's staying. "For the first time in the last 500 years, I'm in the clear. There's no one coming after me," Katherine says.She tells Nadia she should stay, too. Katherine tells Nadia she wants it all: her daughter, immortality and Stefan, her one true love.Stefan comes home to find Caroline sitting in front of his fire. She asks him if she's a horrible person.He asks her what she thought when she found out about him and Katherine. "Honestly, I thought 'ew,'" she says.He points out that if he held it against her, she wouldn't be there. Then he tells her she's horrible and thoughtless and shallow and goes on and on, smiling until she starts laughing.On the way out of town, Aaron stops when he sees a body in the road. It's Enzo. And Damon is there, too.He tells Aaron his family deserved to be killed, and so does he."Elena thinks I'm a monster, and you know what -- she's right," Damon says, as he vamps out and chomps into Aaron's neck, leaving him bleeding out on the pavement."Now that's the Damon Salvatore I remember," Enzo says. Katherine pomocí kouzla ovládla Elenino tělo. Teď se s Nadiou snaží, aby ovládnutí bylo trvalé, což se jim nakonec za pomoci poutnice Mii podaří, i když se Elena pokouší proti kouzlu bojovat. Katherine v Elenině těle se následně rozchází s Damonem a Tyler vyslechne rozhovor Katherine s Caroline, která o Elenině ovládnutí nemá ani tušení, o tom, že se Caroline vyspala s Klausem. To způsobí, že Tyler s Caroline už nic nechce mít. Nadia touží, aby s ní její matka Katherine odjela, ta to odmítá... a chce svést Stefana.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Katherine journals as Elena, loving her life. She particularly loves that she's a vampire again. She goes through Elena's phone and deletes all the photos of her with Damon and makes one of her with Stefan her wallpaper.Caroline, Bonnie and Katherine settle into their seats in class, with Caroline vowing they're going to have fresh starts. She wants them to go to the "Bitter Ball," for singles. Bonnie notices her surly punked out seat neighbor twirling her pen, then continuing doing... so without touching it, even changing direction. The girl stops when she sees Bonnie watching.Stefan comes home to see a BMW with blood leaking out of the truck crashed into the front of his house. He's not happy to see Aaron Whitmore's dead body instead.Inside, Damon is falling down hungover and the house is destroyed. "So Elena breaks up with you, and your first instinct is to go on a killing spree? Could you be any more predictable?" Stefan asks.Enzo introduces himself and Stefan wonders if he's Damon's "murder buddy."Dr. Wes Maxfield is next on their list.Damon kicks himself for being dumb enough to try to change for a girl. He tells Stefan to get a new hobby, because he doesn't want to be saved. "Damon, you're better than this," Stefan says. "On the contrary, I'm better like this," Damon says.Katherine calls Matt to try out her invitation to Stefan. Nadia is there to compel Matt to forget Katherine's queries -- she's using him like her "Elena Gilbert cheat sheet." Nadia cautions her mother that he's not a puppet and Katherine taunts her for liking him.In an abandoned building, Wes Maxfield has his next subject -- Joey, a hospital janitor. Maxfield has already turned him into a vampire, now he's turning him into an Augustine vampire, even though he has no funding.A hot woman wanders into his lab and introduces herself as Sloan. She offers to fund his research if he'll analyze some blood. She has Aaron's book bag and tells Wes that Aaron's car was found abandoned. She tells him he's next.Damon and Enzo go down to the basement where they have Diane, the head of Whitmore security, in the cellar. She pleads, saying she has two children. Once they determine the vervane is out of her system, they compel her to confess to helping cover up the vampire murders on campus as suicides. But she has no idea where Maxfield is. Enzo snaps her neck, Damon is unbothered.Later, Stefan finds Enzo out in the woods burying the body. Stefan suggests Enzo move on and find another buddy to blow off steam. When Enzo dismisses him flippantly, Stefan knocks him off his feet with the shovel and holds the handle over his chest.Enzo doesn't blink, and grabs the handle and pulls it into his chest, noting there's nothing Stefan can do to him that hasn't already been done to him 100 times.Stefan puts the shovel blade across Enzo's throat. "What I do to you, Enzo will be final, you got it? Make sure I never see you again," Stefan says, and leaves him there.When Caroline comes back to her dorm room, she finds it odd that Elena (Katherine) is focusing on accessories. She tells her she doesn't have to pretend she's OK about breaking up with Damon.Stefan calls, saying he needs to talk to Elena about Enzo. Katherine has no idea who he's talking about, but takes the opportunity to invite him to the dance. Caroline finds it a bit odd.Tyler strolls into the Grille and notices Nadia. Matt cautions him she's Katherine's daughter and the crazy doesn't fall far from the tree, but Tyler still suggests shots.Over drinks, they compare bad mothers. Tyler's once wrote an English paper for him, Nadia's compelled an entire town to be her friend, and Matt's hooked up with Tyler.When Tyler goes to the bathroom, Nadia compels Matt for information on Enzo. Tyler hears her.Damon shows up at Whitmore looking for Bonnie to do a locator spell on Maxfield, even though she doesn't have her powers anymore. He gets aggressive with Jeremy and points out the threat of Elena breaking up with him is moot. Enzo joins them and starts crushing Jeremy's skull until Bonnie agrees.At the dance, Katherine gets the Enzo 411 text from Nadia. Stefan finds her. She assures him she's doing great.He warns her he needs to talk to her about Damon and she talks about how he lashes out when he's hurt instead of trying to change. She tells Stefan she tried to change Damon but she thinks he ended up changing her. She asks Stefan if he likes who she is now, but then quickly changes the subject when it gets awkward.Caroline sees them on the dance floor and drags Katherine away.Back at the bar, Tyler tells Matt that Nadia is compelling him and points out his vervane watch is gone. As Nadia texts on the other side of the room, Matt goes to drink vervane-laced coffee.At the shredding station, Caroline shreds photos of Tyler and the drawing Klaus drew for her, saying she's done with both relationships. She starts to caution Elena not to rush into anything but backs off. Katherine immediately moves on.Bonnie brings Damon to the party to find the witch from her class since she can't do the locator spell.Stefan tells Caroline that Damon is off the deep end. He doesn't want to tell Elena what Damon did because he thinks she'll never forgive him and Damon couldn't rebound from that. Stefan thinks Damon acting badly is him trying to confirm everyone's lowest expectations of him.Damon interrupts with Bonnie and they explain that Enzo has Jeremy and if Bonnie doesn't find a witch to do the spell by midnight, Enzo will kill Jeremy, which Damon seems to be fine with.Katherine hears what's going on and looks panicked for Jeremy, but she's really just annoyed by the drama.Katherine goes outside to call Nadia, wondering if she could credibly let Jeremy die. Nadia chews her out, telling her Elena would do everything in her power to save him. Katherine recognized the Whitmore house in the photo of Jeremy -- she's the only one who's been there. Nadia tells her to go save Jeremy now, but also to find out from Matt if Caroline has feelings for Stefan.Matt comes outside and asks Nadia who she keeps talking to. She compels him for info on Caroline and Stefan and he goes along with it. When she leaves, Tyler comes out. He gets as far as "you're not going to believe what I'm about to tell you," before Nadia takes out Tyler.Stefan comes out to check on Katherine. She works up tears and begs Stefan to help her save him.Bonnie approaches Liz the witch. She insists she doesn't know what she's doing, but Caroline scares her into helping.Liz tries to get past the fact vampires are real as Bonnie walks her through the spell. Liz concentrates but only succeeds in bringing down the chandelier. She tells Bonnie she's brought down buildings and hurt people because she can't control her powers.Enzo calls, impatient. Damon suggests they need incentive, so Enzo promises to kill Jeremy soon. Caroline can't believe Damon is going along with it, but he just smirks.At the Whitmore house, Enzo picks up a fire poker and menaces Jeremy, who is tied to a chair. Finally, Enzo puts a plastic bag over Jeremy head until he stops breathing.Bonnie frantically tries to convince Liz to give it another shot.At the Whitmore house, Stefan and Katherine bust in. Katherine reluctantly starts CPR on Jeremy while Stefan takes on Enzo. Katherine starts pounding on Jeremy's chest, mostly out of frustration, until he finally starts breathing again.Katherine takes a piece of wood in the shoulder from Enzo right as Damon walks in. He announces the spell worked and Wes is in Richmond.Stefan looks at Damon in disgust and tells him not to bother coming back. "I wasn't planning on it," Damon says as he walks out.Katherine revels in the turn of events.Back outside the Grille, Tyler comes back from his broken neck. Matt explains that Nadia was compelling him because she wanted to talk about Katherine and knew he was mad at her. Tyler warns him to stay away from Nadia, and Matt agrees.Then when Tyler leaves, Matt gets in Nadia's car. He tells her he handled it but demands to know what's going on. He remembers his own experience hosting her boyfriend Gregor and guesses that Katherine didn't die and is inside Elena. Nadia threatens to kill him but says she hasn't decided what to do with him yet. First, she has to wait until the vervane is out of his system.Damon and Enzo arrive at Wes's makeshift lab. Damon says he was in Mystic Falls for Elena and now that that's over, he doesn't need to go back. He thinks Stefan is done with him, too.When they reach Wes's lab, they're greeted by half a dozen chanting Travelers, including Sloane. Wes introduces them as his back-up. Damon and Enzo are incapacitated with pain in their heads and Wes injects Damon with something.Back in her room, Katherine feigns pain and asks Stefan to get the splinter out of her back. She bares a sexy shoulder. Then she guesses that Damon killed Aaron -- because Damon was able to walk right past the threshold of the Whitmore house and Aaron was the owner.Katherine asks him why he wasn't honest with her.Stefan tells her that from the first moment she started falling for Damon he waited for Damon to screw up so badly she couldn't forgive him, but along the way he saw Damon be there for her in ways he never was and he started to like the person Damon was becoming.Katherine tells him she can't go back after Damon threatened Jeremy, but she'll help him save Damon -- for Stefan. She steps in close and hugs him. She's enjoying the moment when Caroline walks in.Damon wakes up in Wes's lab, worried that Wes injected him with something to make him an Augustine vampire. They hear medical noises and Damon finds Joey chained up. He lets Joey go but starts to vamp out when he sees Joey's blood. Joey asks what's happening. Damon realizes vampire blood is affecting him. "Karma. I'm gonna go ahead and say karma is happening to me," Damon says.Damon attacks Joey and kills him. Enzo calls him off, but doesn't like what he sees. "OK, I can see how this might be a problem," Enzo says. Katherine je stále v těle Eleny a snaží se svést Stefana. Dr. Wes Maxfield i přesto, že ho Aaron zbavil finančního krytí, stále provozuje své pokusy. Tentokrát chytil školního údržbáře a proměnil ho v upíra. Damon poté, co se s ním rozešla Elena, která je ale Katherine v Elenině těle, se připojil k Enzovi a oba zabíjejí každého, kdo se zrovna naskytne. Stále ale pátrají po Wesovi. Aby donutili Bonnie provést lokalizační kouzlo, unesou Jeremyho. Stefan na naléhání falešné Eleny Enza s Damonem... najde a Jeremyho osvobodí. Následně oznámí Damonovi, aby se už nevracel domů. Damon a Enzo následně najdou Wese, ten je ale obklopen poutníky a díky jejich kouzlům se mu podaří Damonovi píchnout látku, která z něho udělá augustiniánského upíra, upíra nebezpečného upírům.

programme.title: Tijelo je dokaz
programme.desc: Chcete vyřešit vraždu? Jen přes moje mrtvoly! Geniální doktorka Huntová a její pitevní stůl v hlavních rolích amerického detektivního seriálu. Doktorka Megan Huntová bývala vynikající neurochirurgyní, až dokud ji autonehoda nepřipravila o cit v rukou. Žena proto začne novou kariéru jako soudní lékařka. Provádí pitvy násilně zemřelých lidí a získané poznatky předává vyšetřovatelům, z nich na prvním místě je její chápavý kolega Peter Dunlop. Megan se však nezajímá jen o běžné stopy po vražedných zbraních: z různých známek na mrtvém těle dokáže vyčíst mnoho skutečností o tom, jak dotyčný žil, jaké měl zdravotní problémy či životní... návyky. Díky tomu Megan sama vytváří teorie o tom, jak a proč se který zločin odehrál. K případu násiln é smrti dvaatřicetileté právničky, která zemřela během ranního joggingu, má vyšetřovatelům Morrisovi a Bakerové hodně co říct. Její vývody jsou však velmi odlišné od toho, k čemu na základě zjevných indicií a policejní rutiny dospějí detektivové. A protože Megan je od přírody prostořeká až arogantní, protože respekt k nadřízeným neuznává a v každém případě si až do poslední chvíle stojí za svým, je o konflikty v jejím okolí bohatě postaráno. Na druhou stranu je Megan skutečný génius... V soukromém životě je to s ní úplně jinak. Kvůli nadměrné pracovní vytíženosti se před pěti lety rozvedla a přišla i o dceru Lacey, které je nyní dvanáct. Když Megan později kvůli nehodě ztratila i svou původní profesi, uvědomila si, jak jí rodina chybí. Obnovit vztah s dcerou, která žije u otce Todda Fleminga, však bude složitější oříšek, než jakákoliv nevyřešená vražda..

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí. Bobbyho hasičský tím zachraňuje deti, ktoré na narodeninovej oslave uviazli v nafukovacom dome zachytenom na skale, a vyslobodzuje utečencov zamknutých v kamióne na parkovisku. Hasič Chimney sa poháda s priateľkou, ktorá odmietla jeho žiadosť o ruku. Rozrušený jazdí obrovskou rýchlosťou mestom a pri autonehode si zraní hlavu. Policajná dôstojníčka Athena sa vyrovnáva s dôsledkami pokusu svojej dcéry o samovraždu.

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí. Havária lietadla v Los Angeles zamestná všetkých záchranárov. Athena prijme drastické opatrenia na ochranu svojej dcéry, za čo ju suspendujú a potrestajú prácou v kancelárii. Po záchrane obetí z havarovaného lietadla sa Bobby vráti k svojmu alkoholizmu. Abby čelí vážnej situácii so svojou matkou. Pred pristátím na letisku v Los Angeles dôjde k havárii lietadla, ktoré núdzovo pristane na mori. Záchranári majú pohotovosť a musia okamžite ponáhľať na miesto havárie, pretože stroj sa potápa.... Athena prichádza rovno z oslavy narodenín Laily Creedyovej, spolužiačky svojej dcéry May, ktorú Laila š ikanovala. Athena na oslave Lailu zatkne za držanie drog, všetkým je ale jasné, že sa chce pomstiť za May. Po príchode k lietadlu sa Bobbyho tím snaží zachrániť všetkých, čo prežili. Väčšina ľudí na palube však pri havárii zahynula. Tammy, jedna z pasažierok, zostala pripútaná k sedadlu a nemožno ju jednoducho vyslobodiť. Bobby pošle Bucka, aby odviedol jej syna Jakea, a sám s Tammy zostáva v potápajúcom sa lietadle, aby ju nakoniec zachránil. Operátorka Abby požiada Bucka, aby sa pokúsil nájsť cestujúceho Dalea Marksa, ktorý jej tesne pred pádom telefonoval na tiesňovú linku. Buck zisťuje, že Dale je mŕtvy a Abby musí túto správu oznámiť Daleovej tehotnej manželke. Bobby prežil priveľmi náročný deň, vracajú sa mu spomienky z minulosti a znovu prepadne alkoholu. Pre zatknutie školáčky za držanie drog na vlastnej narodeninovej párty Athenu dočasne suspendujú a musí pracovať v kancelárii za stolom. Na tiesňovú linku v Los Angeles denne volajú desiatky ľudí, ktorí sa ocitli v núdzovej situácii. Hasiči, policajti, záchranári a dispečeri zasahujú nielen v týchto nebezpečných situáciách, ale zároveň bojujú s vlastnými problémami a v súkromí pomáhajú svojim rodinám, známym a blízkym. Okrem toho, že títo moderní hrdinovia každý deň zachraňujú životy cudzích a neznámych ľudí, musia si nájsť čas aj na riešenie svojich vlastných osobných problémov, od ktorých neustále odbiehajú, aby pomáhali druhým.

programme.title: Susjedstvo
programme.desc: Přátelský chlapík ze Středozápadu se snaží zapadnout do drsné LA. Co se stane, když nejpřátelštější chlapík na Středozápadě přestěhuje svou rodinu do drsné čtvrti v Los Angeles, kde ne každý vypadá jako on nebo oceňuje jeho extrémní sousedskou laskavost.

programme.desc: Al se rozhodne zabránit kojení tím, že začne v obchodě prodávat pánské potřeby. Znenadání však přijede šéf..

programme.title: Bračne vode
programme.desc: Bud začne pracovat na panenské horké lince. Al a Peggy jdou mezitím do obchodu s videokazetama.

programme.title: Bračne vode
programme.desc: Nespokojený prodavač bot, jeho obtížná žena a jejich dvě nezvládnutelné dospívající děti řeší radosti a strasti běžného života na předměstí Chicaga. Al Bunda je celkem roztomilý chlapík. Má kousavou manželku Peggy, nadrženého syna Buda, hloupou ale krásnou dceru Kelly a začínající pleš. A taky prodává boty. Al Bunda alias Dr. Bota vám kdykoliv poradí, ať máte jakýkoliv problém s botami. Ale teď ho prosím nerušte, právě začíná jeho oblíbený televizní program Táta Cvok a tak si Al musí vyvrtět ten správný důlek na prosezeném gauči a elegantně zavěsit pravičku za spodky.

programme.title: Uvod u anatomiju
programme.desc: Seznamte se. To je Meredith Greyová (Ellen Pompeo) - mladá, úspěšná, krásná dívka. Před nedávnem dokončila medicínu a nyní nastupuje jako začínající stážistka v Seattle Grace. Spolu se svými kamarády (Cristina, Alex,Izzie, George) překonává problémy, které ji začínající kariéra přináší a my sledujeme jejich boj o "přežití". Dramatický, vtipný, příjemný - přesně taková slova se hodí na seriál Chirurgové. Seriál získal dva Zlaté Glóby a v USA boří rekordy ve sledovanosti.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: In a farm house, Damon and Enzo wait for the farmer to come back to life. Now that Damon has to feed on vampires, they're turning people so he can feed on them.Enzo is staying, saying he doesn't abandon his friends. Plus, if Damon hadn't gone with him to kill Dr. Wes, Damon wouldn't have been turned into a vampire killer. When the farmer wakes up, they feed him blood so he'll turn. Then Damon rips his head off.At the Salvatore house, Stefan quizzes Katherine-in-Elena on dates in history. She... knows a little too much about the Holy Roman Empire, which Katherine lived through. Stefan takes no te. She quickly tries to cover, saying she did a paper on it in high school.Caroline comes by with police reports from her mom. Katherine is annoyed to have her alone time with Stefan interrupted.The police reports show a string of people found inside their own homes with their heads ripped off and skin desiccated. Stefan realizes it means Damon is feeding on vampires.Stefan tries to blame himself, but Caroline won't allow it. Caroline is surprised to see Elena there, and doesn't buy her excuse that Stefan -- who doesn't go to college -- was helping her study.Tyler calls Caroline. They haven't spoken since, as Stefan puts it, Tyler tried to kill her. Katherine overhears as Tyler asks about Matt and tells her Nadia was compelling him and now he hasn't been home or to work. Stefan seems to see Katherine/Elena alarmed as she listens in. Caroline insists on coming over to Tyler's.Elena leaves and Caroline worries about whatever is going on with her, pointing out she went from planning to fight for Damon to dumping him to spending time with Stefan. Stefan is confident that he'll figure out whatever's going on with her on their trip to find Damon.Back at Whitmore, Katherine calls Nadia. When Nadia tells her that Matt knows about her, Katherine insists Nadia kill him. But Nadia has been keeping him hidden until the vervane is out of his system so she can re-compel him.Katherine tells Nadia to deal with Matt before she gets back in town or she'll do it. When Nadia gets off the phone he promises her he can convince his friends he's OK.Damon and Enzo prepare to leave the farmhouse for New York when Damon hears the telltale chanting of Travelers outside. They open the door and find they are stuck inside -- and Wes Maxfield is there. Damon is his patient zero and he wants to see how long Damon can go before he feeds on his best friend. They're trapped.Stefan and Elena stop for gas. He notices that she seems to have written Damon off in a way she hasn't before and Katherine tries to play it off as just wanting off the Damon redemption rollercoaster. She sends him inside for food then sabotages his engine.At the farmhouse, Enzo knows Damon can go eight hours without feeding. Damon doesn't want to call Stefan after he told him to leave and not come back. Enzo thinks Damon is willing to risk him, but not his friends. Damon assures him he's not going to feed on him.At Tyler's house, they get past the awkward silence and start to talk about Matt, when he walks in the door, followed by Nadia. He says he was with her, then invites her in.Back at the gas station, Stefan finds the piece of his car Katherine ripped out. He asks her to hold the part, noting it has grease on it. When he's looking into the engine, she rubs grease all over herself. Then she cutely suggests they get a room at nearby hotel to shower and change. He tries to insist on staying with his car while it gets fixed, but she convinces him to join her.Back at Tyler's house, Matt spins a yarn about being on the way out of town but finding Nadia waiting for him on his front steps. She tells Tyler she feels bad about snapping his neck. Matt says he lost his phone and they were in Atlantic City, but Caroline isn't buying it.She tries to compel Matt to tell the truth, but he gives the same answer with his vervane bracelet on.Nadia turns on Caroline for being judgmental over Matt's romantic choices given her own. She tries to draw Tyler into it, but he leaves.Caroline follows Tyler, not able to believe he's buying their story. "It's a hell of a lot easier to buy than other things that have happened," Tyler says as he walks out the door.At the motel, Stefan tells Elena (Katherine) that he understands what Damon is going through because he was in love with her once and lost her. He doesn't think Damon is handling it properly, but he sympathizes. Katherine brushes his hand with hers but he goes to change.Back at the farmhouse, Enzo chains Damon to a chair (with his permission). Then Enzo calls for back-up. "I told you your pride isn't worth either of our lives," Enzo says to Damon's objections.He calls Stefan, but Stefan isn't near his phone and Katherine answers. Enzo catches her up to speed as Damon shouts in the background for them not to come. Katherine tells him to text her the address and they'll be on their way. He tells her he's under strict orders to kill Damon if he tries to feed on her. He's kidding but it gives her an idea. She doesn't tell Stefan about the call.At the farmhouse, Damon is worried he'll feed on them if they come. Suddenly, there's a shot. Wes shot Enzo in the shoulder to see if Damon would get hungry enough at the smell of his blood to break the chains.Damon busts through easily and attacks Enzo. Enzo tries to remain calm and yells at Damon to stop. Finally, Damon pulls off and starts wretching.Wes tells him the Travelers raised the acidity of his blood so Damon was essentially drinking hydrochloric acid. He'll allow Enzo to leave because he wants something from him. At first, Enzo insists on staying, but Damon tells him he tried to kill him once and he'll do it again. He yells at Enzo to leave and he finally does.Back in the motel room, Stefan gets word that his car is fixed. Katherine showers and does everything she can to tempt Stefan, including leaving the door open when she gets dressed. She walks over to him with dripping wet hair and presses up against him. She kisses him. He tries to resist and finally breaks away, saying it's wrong because she just split up with Damon.She apologizes and suggests he settle the bill while she finishes packing. When he leaves, she enjoys her first victory.She calls Nadia, wondering who Stefan loves more: Elena or Damon. She wants to make Damon attack her so that Stefan has to kill him to save her.When Nadia gets off the phone, Matt tells her she's an idiot if she thinks Katherine will choose her. He knows what it's like to have a mom who only cares when it was convenient. Nadia brushes him off, adding that he's just trying to save Elena.She bites his wrist and announces the vervane is gone. He kisses her, since he's going to forget it anyway. He thanks her. "If I'm going to be threatened and held against my will I can think of worse scenarios," he says.She wants more and kisses him. He rolls on top of her and takes out a phone. He sends a text. He gets as far as "Help. K-" when she sees.She's upset and feels betrayed by him. He tells her she's not like her mom, she compels him to forget everything. She gets up to leave but runs into Caroline at the front door.Matt sent a text to her from Nadia's phone, but now has no memory of it. Caroline sees he was compelled again and attacks Nadia.Nadia gets the better of her. Nadia tells Matt that he may not remember, but this is all his fault. She's about to attack Caroline when Tyler races through the door. He announces that young hybrid beats old vampire and wrestles with her, but she gets free and runs off. Matt looks for an explanation.In the farmhouse, Katherine and Stefan arrive. He warns them not to come in. Stefan says he's not afraid of him. Katherine calculates then steps into the farmhouse, which she can't leave due to the Travelers' spell.She tells Damon she's proving to him that he's not a lost cause. Stefan follows her in. She picks up a shard of ceramic and cuts her hand, tempting him, saying his love for her is stronger than his craving.Damon vamps out and tries to resist, but shouts at her to get away. She toys with him in the guise of being helpful. Stefan tries to stop her, but she tells him Damon will be OK.She pushes her bleeding hand in Damon's face until finally he can't resist anymore. He chomps down on her neck.Katherine waits for Stefan to save her. As Damon gnaws away, she even kicks a handy stake closer to Stefan's feet.But Stefan doesn't want to hurt Damon. Instead he picks up a shard of glass and cuts his own arm, tempting Damon away from Katherine. Then he snaps Damon's neck.Back at Tyler's house, Caroline reports to Tyler that the only thing Matt remembers is he slept with Nadia (the cover story she gave him).She turns to go, but Tyler stops her to apologize. She tells him she wants things to be good, but he reminds her she slept with the guy who killed his mom, so they're not going to be good.Damon wakes up chained in his own cellar. He tells Stefan he's stupid for bringing him home and eventually he'll kill him. But Stefan reminds Damon he's his brother and won't give up on him.Damon thinks Elena has. She knew what being an Augustine vampire meant for Damon. She had to kill Jesse when he was one because it was the only way. And Damon saw her kick Stefan a stake."Are you saying Elena wanted me to kill you?" Stefan asks. "You got another excuse?"Stefan thinks about it and leaves.Katherine joins Nadia in a diner. She giddily tells Nadia that she had a moment with Stefan. Nadia is disappointed that it's all Katherine cares about."I'm in a really good mood right now, which means I don't want to have to worry about whatever's making you mopey," Katherine says."You won't have to worry about me much longer," Nadia says. "Tyler Lockwood bit me."Nadia reveals a bite on her arm.Back at the Salvatore house, Caroline shows Stefan her "Help. K" text from Matt. Stefan tells Caroline that Elena (Katherine) is acting strange and kissed him.Caroline doesn't understand, and knows that would destroy Damon.He tells her Damon's theory, but Caroline doesn't think Elena would ever want Damon dead."Unless... Matt texted you 'Help. K' before Nadia stopped him. K. As in Katherine," he says. He remembers Nadia trying to transfer Katherine's spirit to her as she was dying."But that didn't happen because Katherine had a change of heart," Caroline says.Then they both realize what actually happened."It's Elena, we know her! Oh my god," Caroline says. Tyler přišel na to, že Matt je ovládnutý. Když to Katherine zjistí, dává Nadie příkaz, aby Nadia zabila Matta. Wes s pomocí poutníků nastraží past na Damona a Enza. Oba zůstanou uvězněni v malém domě, kde předtím zabili farmáře. Wes doufá, že když oba upíři nebudou moct vyjít ven, Damon nakonec zabije Enza a jeho krví se nakrmí. Enzo zavolá o pomoc Stefana a Elenu. Ti nakonec dorazí a Damona osvobodí z chaty, Stefan ho ale připoutá řetězy v jejich sídle. Matt se pokusí zachránit Elenu, v... jejímž těle je teď Katherine, a to vyvolá souboj Tylera a Nadii. Nadia je Tylerem pokousaná a začíná um írat. Stefanovi dojde, že v Elenině těle je schovaná Katherine.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Northern Europe, 1520Nadia knocks on someone's door, looking for Katrina Petrova, he rmother.Back in Mystic Falls, Nadia is feverish from her hybrid bite from Tyler. Her sore is festering. Katherine is sitting at her side and heard her talking about being abandoned.Nadia knows her mother wouldn't risk calling Klaus for his blood -- the only cure for werewolf bite -- because she wouldn't want to risk being outed for traveling in Elena's body. So instead she called Dr. Wes Maxfield, who's... excited to study werewolf blood. He assures Nadia he can create an antidote."If I'd known I just had to die to drag your attention, I would have tried it a long time ago," Nadia tells her mother. Katherine promises to be a better mother, starting right now. "I'm going to save your life," she says.Stefan fills Damon in on Katherine in Elena. "She's brilliant," is all he has to say.Caroline updates Matt and Tyler, and Bonnie and Jeremy via speakerphone.They take turns feeling burned by Katherine: Stefan for being lured to a hotel for a make-out session and Tyler for learning about Caroline with Klaus. They know the Traveler knife will kick her out of Elena, but think she'll see it coming. Tyler mentions he thinks he bit Nadia, so Katherine's probably at her side. So instead, they have to invite her to something that Elena can't say no to.They plan a surprise party for Bonnie's birthday next week. Caroline calls her, but Katherine says she has to make arrangements for Aaron Whitmore's funeral.Bonnie calls, wanting moral support for a rough day. Katherine tells her she's at the spa buying Bonnie a gift certificate for her birthday and can't come.Down in the cellar, Stefan feeds Damon 4 ounces of his blood, figuring that some every few hours will stave off his hunger.Katherine calls Damon, wanting to talk. He invites her by the house.When she hangs up, Katherine assesses. She knows Damon would never put Elena in harms way again after nearly killing her. So he must know.Stefan and Damon come to the same conclusion: she knows.Nadia remembers tracking her mother's trail to France.She wakes up in a church, where Katherine has moved her until Wes comes up with a cure.At the Salvatore's, Caroline and Stefan try to figure what to do next. Damon suggests a locator spell.Bonnie and Jeremy track down the young witch Liv who helped them track down Jeremy. She's willing to help, but has eyes on Jeremy.Tyler sits guard outside Damon's cellar. Damon asks him what he's still doing in Mystic Fall with his whole family dead. He thinks Tyler is convinced there's still a chance with Caroline.Damon taunts him about Caroline until Tyler comes close enough to bite. Then Damon breaks free and runs.Caroline and Stefan show up. Tyler thinks Damon's after Wes.In Elena's dorm room, Bonnie watches as Liv takes Jeremy's hand to help him find Elena, while also hitting on him. "Does your sister spend a lot of time in church?" Liv asks.In the church, Katherine gets impatient and goes to find Wes.In his makeshift lab, Wes finishes up with the werewolf antidote. He hears a noise and soon Damon is yanking the cell phone out of his hand. As Damon threatens him, Wes reaches for a syringe. But soon, Damon gets impatient and jams his hand into Wes's chest. Damon throws him on a table and goes at his eye with a scalpel.Nadia remembers being in bed with Matt after meeting him while he was with Rebekah in Europe. She tells him about wanting to find Katherine.Katherine shows up at Wes's lab and finds him dead. Her phone rings, it's Stefan calling from Nadia's phone. Stefan won't entertain her attempts to pretend she's Elena. He offers her one last chance to say good-bye to Nadia.Matt brings Nadia a pillow to make her more comfortable. Nadia thinks he's Gregor. "I'm sorry I betrayed you, I did it for my mother, I did everything for her. Forgive me?" she asks.Matt goes along with it. "Yes, I forgive you," he says.Everyone else arrives. Nadia asks Bonnie what will happen when she dies. Bonnie promises she won't feel any pain.Suddenly Katherine walks in the front door and walks straight toward Nadia. "I'm here to see my daughter," she says.Katherine takes Nadia's hand and kneels at her side. Katherine admits Klaus's blood would have saved her if she'd asked, but she would have outed herself. And now it's too late.Nadia starts hallucinating again. "My mother's name is Katherine. She's a liar, and a murderer. She manipulates and betrays, she'll do anything to survive," she says."This is not what your life should have been, searching for a mother who ended up being me," Katherine says.Katherine offers to show her what her life should have been. She shows Nadia a scene of her as a young girl and Katherine tucking her in at night. "Your mother loves you," Katherine says as Nadia dies in front of her.Bonnie sees her spirit on the other side of the room and takes her hand. Katherine covers up her daughter and then turns to face Stefan, Matt, Bonnie, Jeremy, Tyler and Caroline. "So, this is it?" she says.Damon arrives, there's no way she'd miss it. She waits to see who has the knife. Tyler? Because she gave him the werewolf curse and gave him an identity and made him matter. Or Caroline? Who she "made better by making a vampire." Or Matt? When she's the one girl who appreciates him. Or Jeremy? It was nice to have a brother for a second there, when he wasn't being so damn annoying.She turns to face Damon. He points out he's already done this, and said all he needs to say. She, naturally, has something to say. She apologizes for turning him. "I'm sorry that you didn't get to die as a forgotten nobody on a bloody battlefield, that your father didn't get to live another day to be disgraced by you. Damon, I'm sorry that I gave your life passion, purpose, drive, desire. I'm sorry that you are who you are, because I'm the one who taught you how to love," she says."I'll see you in hell, Katherine," Damon says.Finally, Katherine turns to Stefan. She admits she always wondered what it'd be like to be loved by him. "You've got to admit, for a moment, your feelings were real. Stefan, I love you and I've always loved you," she says.Katherine kisses him. And he stabs her. "I guess this is how our love story ends," she says, and crumples to the floor.She slumps against he couch, next to Nadia's desiccated body, her eyes flashing briefly black.Later, Matt sits next to Nadia's dead body. Stefan suggested burying her in the woods, but Matt thinks she deserves better. He picks up her body and carries her out.Stefan and Damon sit next to Elena, waiting for her to wake up. Stefan asks Damon's plan. He's going to tell Elena everything he did and let the chips fall where they may -- he's determined not to be another Katherine and spend his whole life running.Outside, Caroline admits to Tyler that she feels a little bad that Katherine is dead. He throws it back in her face, saying it's because she sees the good in everyone. It's another Klaus dig. She points out that his bite just killed Nadia and no one is batting an eye. She points out she has the same urges as him and it's hard for her to be good. She tells him she's tired of feeling guilty, and it's time for him to get over it.In the church, Bonnie lights a candle for her dad. Katherine's ghost laughs at her. She's there to cross over, but Katherine is bitter. She's tired of Elena always getting what she wants. Wes never had any intention of helping her.Flash to Katherine finding Wes dead. She plays his recorded notes, using Nadia's blood to boost the ripper virus with werewolf virus. She tells Bonnie that she wasn't about to just go easy.Flash to Katherine injecting herself with Wes's virus. She left Elena with a parting gift.Elena, back to her old self, wakes up with Damon and Stefan watching over her. There's another syringe in her pocket.In the church, Katherine pronounces herself ready to go and touches Bonnie. Nothing happens. She tries again. Nothing happens.Katherine gets angry, asking why she can't pass through. Bonnie explains she doesn't control it. Katherine asks who it's up to as Katherine is blown backward off her feet and dragged by an unseen force, out of the church, screaming. Nadia umírá a Katherine v těle Eleny u ní přebývá. Ostatní upíři se Katherine snaží najít, aby ji mohli zabít pomocí poutnického nože. Damon se dokáže osvobodit a následně napadnout Wesleyho, kterého zabije. Upíři zjistí, kde Katherine umírající Nadiu skrývá, a vyrazí tam za ní. Všichni se sejdou nad umírající Nadiou, ani Katherine neuteče, i když ji o to Nadia žádala. Ve chvíli, kdy Nadia zemře a Bonnie ji převede do podsvětí, upíři zabijí Katherine poutnickým nožem.

programme.title: Visok potencijal
programme.desc: Morgan je samoživitelka s výjimečně bystrou myslí. Její nekonvenční talent pro řešení zločinů vede k neobvyklému, ale nezastavitelnému partnerství se zkušeným detektivem, který se striktně drží pravidel. Morgan, svobodná matka se třemi dětmi a výjimečnou myslí, pomůže vyřešit nevyřešitelný zločin, když během své směny jako uklízečka na policejním oddělení přerovná důkazy. Když policie zjistí, že má díky svému vysokému intelektuálnímu potenciálu talent dávat věci do pořádku, je přijata jako konzultantka, aby spolupracovala s ostříleným detektivem Karadecem. Společně tvoří neobvyklý a neporazitelný tým.

programme.title: Uvod u anatomiju
programme.desc: Seznamte se. To je Meredith Greyová (Ellen Pompeo) - mladá, úspěšná, krásná dívka. Před nedávnem dokončila medicínu a nyní nastupuje jako začínající stážistka v Seattle Grace. Spolu se svými kamarády (Cristina, Alex,Izzie, George) překonává problémy, které ji začínající kariéra přináší a my sledujeme jejich boj o "přežití". Dramatický, vtipný, příjemný - přesně taková slova se hodí na seriál Chirurgové. Seriál získal dva Zlaté Glóby a v USA boří rekordy ve sledovanosti.

programme.title: Miris žene
programme.desc: V New Yorku probíhají oslavy Dne díkuvzdání a bývalý důstojník Frank Slade si chce ještě užít alespoň trochu ze života: krásné ženy, dobré jídlo, limuzíny se šoférem a pokoj v hotelu Waldorf-Astoria. A mladý student Charlie Simms ho - ze začátku trochu neochotně -doprovází, aby tím získal velkou školu života. Slade je vskutku zajímavou osobností: bývalý poradce Lyndona Johnsona, nyní slepý, velmi zahořklý, avšak s duší básníka. Charlie je mladičký student řešící své životní kotrmelce. Jejich... společné hořce veselé dobrodružství je má oba navždy změnit. Slepota změnila plukovníka Franka Sladea v zatrpknutého, osamělého a cynického člověka, kterému se už nechce žít. Než se rozhodne definitivně skončit se svým životem, chce se ještě jednou pořádně pobavit. Spolu se studentem Charliem, kterého mu Sladeova rodina najala jako opatrovníka, odchází do New Yorku a jeho poslední výlet nekončí plánovanou sebevraždou. Slade si s Chrisovou pomocí začne znovu uvědomovat krásy života a pomalu se změní na energického muže, jakým kdysi býval. Mezi slepcem... a Chrisem postupně vzniká sympatie a důvěra. Slade pomůže chlapcovi vyřešit i jeho školní problémy. Vůně ženy je jednoznačně hereckým a mistrovským sólem Al Pacina. Za svůj výkon slepého důstojníka získal svého prvního Oscara /1993/ a Zlatý glóbus /1993/ za nejlepší mužský herecký výkon.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: In a farm house, Damon and Enzo wait for the farmer to come back to life. Now that Damon has to feed on vampires, they're turning people so he can feed on them.Enzo is staying, saying he doesn't abandon his friends. Plus, if Damon hadn't gone with him to kill Dr. Wes, Damon wouldn't have been turned into a vampire killer. When the farmer wakes up, they feed him blood so he'll turn. Then Damon rips his head off.At the Salvatore house, Stefan quizzes Katherine-in-Elena on dates in history. She... knows a little too much about the Holy Roman Empire, which Katherine lived through. Stefan takes no te. She quickly tries to cover, saying she did a paper on it in high school.Caroline comes by with police reports from her mom. Katherine is annoyed to have her alone time with Stefan interrupted.The police reports show a string of people found inside their own homes with their heads ripped off and skin desiccated. Stefan realizes it means Damon is feeding on vampires.Stefan tries to blame himself, but Caroline won't allow it. Caroline is surprised to see Elena there, and doesn't buy her excuse that Stefan -- who doesn't go to college -- was helping her study.Tyler calls Caroline. They haven't spoken since, as Stefan puts it, Tyler tried to kill her. Katherine overhears as Tyler asks about Matt and tells her Nadia was compelling him and now he hasn't been home or to work. Stefan seems to see Katherine/Elena alarmed as she listens in. Caroline insists on coming over to Tyler's.Elena leaves and Caroline worries about whatever is going on with her, pointing out she went from planning to fight for Damon to dumping him to spending time with Stefan. Stefan is confident that he'll figure out whatever's going on with her on their trip to find Damon.Back at Whitmore, Katherine calls Nadia. When Nadia tells her that Matt knows about her, Katherine insists Nadia kill him. But Nadia has been keeping him hidden until the vervane is out of his system so she can re-compel him.Katherine tells Nadia to deal with Matt before she gets back in town or she'll do it. When Nadia gets off the phone he promises her he can convince his friends he's OK.Damon and Enzo prepare to leave the farmhouse for New York when Damon hears the telltale chanting of Travelers outside. They open the door and find they are stuck inside -- and Wes Maxfield is there. Damon is his patient zero and he wants to see how long Damon can go before he feeds on his best friend. They're trapped.Stefan and Elena stop for gas. He notices that she seems to have written Damon off in a way she hasn't before and Katherine tries to play it off as just wanting off the Damon redemption rollercoaster. She sends him inside for food then sabotages his engine.At the farmhouse, Enzo knows Damon can go eight hours without feeding. Damon doesn't want to call Stefan after he told him to leave and not come back. Enzo thinks Damon is willing to risk him, but not his friends. Damon assures him he's not going to feed on him.At Tyler's house, they get past the awkward silence and start to talk about Matt, when he walks in the door, followed by Nadia. He says he was with her, then invites her in.Back at the gas station, Stefan finds the piece of his car Katherine ripped out. He asks her to hold the part, noting it has grease on it. When he's looking into the engine, she rubs grease all over herself. Then she cutely suggests they get a room at nearby hotel to shower and change. He tries to insist on staying with his car while it gets fixed, but she convinces him to join her.Back at Tyler's house, Matt spins a yarn about being on the way out of town but finding Nadia waiting for him on his front steps. She tells Tyler she feels bad about snapping his neck. Matt says he lost his phone and they were in Atlantic City, but Caroline isn't buying it.She tries to compel Matt to tell the truth, but he gives the same answer with his vervane bracelet on.Nadia turns on Caroline for being judgmental over Matt's romantic choices given her own. She tries to draw Tyler into it, but he leaves.Caroline follows Tyler, not able to believe he's buying their story. "It's a hell of a lot easier to buy than other things that have happened," Tyler says as he walks out the door.At the motel, Stefan tells Elena (Katherine) that he understands what Damon is going through because he was in love with her once and lost her. He doesn't think Damon is handling it properly, but he sympathizes. Katherine brushes his hand with hers but he goes to change.Back at the farmhouse, Enzo chains Damon to a chair (with his permission). Then Enzo calls for back-up. "I told you your pride isn't worth either of our lives," Enzo says to Damon's objections.He calls Stefan, but Stefan isn't near his phone and Katherine answers. Enzo catches her up to speed as Damon shouts in the background for them not to come. Katherine tells him to text her the address and they'll be on their way. He tells her he's under strict orders to kill Damon if he tries to feed on her. He's kidding but it gives her an idea. She doesn't tell Stefan about the call.At the farmhouse, Damon is worried he'll feed on them if they come. Suddenly, there's a shot. Wes shot Enzo in the shoulder to see if Damon would get hungry enough at the smell of his blood to break the chains.Damon busts through easily and attacks Enzo. Enzo tries to remain calm and yells at Damon to stop. Finally, Damon pulls off and starts wretching.Wes tells him the Travelers raised the acidity of his blood so Damon was essentially drinking hydrochloric acid. He'll allow Enzo to leave because he wants something from him. At first, Enzo insists on staying, but Damon tells him he tried to kill him once and he'll do it again. He yells at Enzo to leave and he finally does.Back in the motel room, Stefan gets word that his car is fixed. Katherine showers and does everything she can to tempt Stefan, including leaving the door open when she gets dressed. She walks over to him with dripping wet hair and presses up against him. She kisses him. He tries to resist and finally breaks away, saying it's wrong because she just split up with Damon.She apologizes and suggests he settle the bill while she finishes packing. When he leaves, she enjoys her first victory.She calls Nadia, wondering who Stefan loves more: Elena or Damon. She wants to make Damon attack her so that Stefan has to kill him to save her.When Nadia gets off the phone, Matt tells her she's an idiot if she thinks Katherine will choose her. He knows what it's like to have a mom who only cares when it was convenient. Nadia brushes him off, adding that he's just trying to save Elena.She bites his wrist and announces the vervane is gone. He kisses her, since he's going to forget it anyway. He thanks her. "If I'm going to be threatened and held against my will I can think of worse scenarios," he says.She wants more and kisses him. He rolls on top of her and takes out a phone. He sends a text. He gets as far as "Help. K-" when she sees.She's upset and feels betrayed by him. He tells her she's not like her mom, she compels him to forget everything. She gets up to leave but runs into Caroline at the front door.Matt sent a text to her from Nadia's phone, but now has no memory of it. Caroline sees he was compelled again and attacks Nadia.Nadia gets the better of her. Nadia tells Matt that he may not remember, but this is all his fault. She's about to attack Caroline when Tyler races through the door. He announces that young hybrid beats old vampire and wrestles with her, but she gets free and runs off. Matt looks for an explanation.In the farmhouse, Katherine and Stefan arrive. He warns them not to come in. Stefan says he's not afraid of him. Katherine calculates then steps into the farmhouse, which she can't leave due to the Travelers' spell.She tells Damon she's proving to him that he's not a lost cause. Stefan follows her in. She picks up a shard of ceramic and cuts her hand, tempting him, saying his love for her is stronger than his craving.Damon vamps out and tries to resist, but shouts at her to get away. She toys with him in the guise of being helpful. Stefan tries to stop her, but she tells him Damon will be OK.She pushes her bleeding hand in Damon's face until finally he can't resist anymore. He chomps down on her neck.Katherine waits for Stefan to save her. As Damon gnaws away, she even kicks a handy stake closer to Stefan's feet.But Stefan doesn't want to hurt Damon. Instead he picks up a shard of glass and cuts his own arm, tempting Damon away from Katherine. Then he snaps Damon's neck.Back at Tyler's house, Caroline reports to Tyler that the only thing Matt remembers is he slept with Nadia (the cover story she gave him).She turns to go, but Tyler stops her to apologize. She tells him she wants things to be good, but he reminds her she slept with the guy who killed his mom, so they're not going to be good.Damon wakes up chained in his own cellar. He tells Stefan he's stupid for bringing him home and eventually he'll kill him. But Stefan reminds Damon he's his brother and won't give up on him.Damon thinks Elena has. She knew what being an Augustine vampire meant for Damon. She had to kill Jesse when he was one because it was the only way. And Damon saw her kick Stefan a stake."Are you saying Elena wanted me to kill you?" Stefan asks. "You got another excuse?"Stefan thinks about it and leaves.Katherine joins Nadia in a diner. She giddily tells Nadia that she had a moment with Stefan. Nadia is disappointed that it's all Katherine cares about."I'm in a really good mood right now, which means I don't want to have to worry about whatever's making you mopey," Katherine says."You won't have to worry about me much longer," Nadia says. "Tyler Lockwood bit me."Nadia reveals a bite on her arm.Back at the Salvatore house, Caroline shows Stefan her "Help. K" text from Matt. Stefan tells Caroline that Elena (Katherine) is acting strange and kissed him.Caroline doesn't understand, and knows that would destroy Damon.He tells her Damon's theory, but Caroline doesn't think Elena would ever want Damon dead."Unless... Matt texted you 'Help. K' before Nadia stopped him. K. As in Katherine," he says. He remembers Nadia trying to transfer Katherine's spirit to her as she was dying."But that didn't happen because Katherine had a change of heart," Caroline says.Then they both realize what actually happened."It's Elena, we know her! Oh my god," Caroline says. Tyler přišel na to, že Matt je ovládnutý. Když to Katherine zjistí, dává Nadie příkaz, aby Nadia zabila Matta. Wes s pomocí poutníků nastraží past na Damona a Enza. Oba zůstanou uvězněni v malém domě, kde předtím zabili farmáře. Wes doufá, že když oba upíři nebudou moct vyjít ven, Damon nakonec zabije Enza a jeho krví se nakrmí. Enzo zavolá o pomoc Stefana a Elenu. Ti nakonec dorazí a Damona osvobodí z chaty, Stefan ho ale připoutá řetězy v jejich sídle. Matt se pokusí zachránit Elenu, v... jejímž těle je teď Katherine, a to vyvolá souboj Tylera a Nadii. Nadia je Tylerem pokousaná a začíná um írat. Stefanovi dojde, že v Elenině těle je schovaná Katherine.

programme.title: Vampirski dnevnici
programme.desc: Northern Europe, 1520Nadia knocks on someone's door, looking for Katrina Petrova, he rmother.Back in Mystic Falls, Nadia is feverish from her hybrid bite from Tyler. Her sore is festering. Katherine is sitting at her side and heard her talking about being abandoned.Nadia knows her mother wouldn't risk calling Klaus for his blood -- the only cure for werewolf bite -- because she wouldn't want to risk being outed for traveling in Elena's body. So instead she called Dr. Wes Maxfield, who's... excited to study werewolf blood. He assures Nadia he can create an antidote."If I'd known I just had to die to drag your attention, I would have tried it a long time ago," Nadia tells her mother. Katherine promises to be a better mother, starting right now. "I'm going to save your life," she says.Stefan fills Damon in on Katherine in Elena. "She's brilliant," is all he has to say.Caroline updates Matt and Tyler, and Bonnie and Jeremy via speakerphone.They take turns feeling burned by Katherine: Stefan for being lured to a hotel for a make-out session and Tyler for learning about Caroline with Klaus. They know the Traveler knife will kick her out of Elena, but think she'll see it coming. Tyler mentions he thinks he bit Nadia, so Katherine's probably at her side. So instead, they have to invite her to something that Elena can't say no to.They plan a surprise party for Bonnie's birthday next week. Caroline calls her, but Katherine says she has to make arrangements for Aaron Whitmore's funeral.Bonnie calls, wanting moral support for a rough day. Katherine tells her she's at the spa buying Bonnie a gift certificate for her birthday and can't come.Down in the cellar, Stefan feeds Damon 4 ounces of his blood, figuring that some every few hours will stave off his hunger.Katherine calls Damon, wanting to talk. He invites her by the house.When she hangs up, Katherine assesses. She knows Damon would never put Elena in harms way again after nearly killing her. So he must know.Stefan and Damon come to the same conclusion: she knows.Nadia remembers tracking her mother's trail to France.She wakes up in a church, where Katherine has moved her until Wes comes up with a cure.At the Salvatore's, Caroline and Stefan try to figure what to do next. Damon suggests a locator spell.Bonnie and Jeremy track down the young witch Liv who helped them track down Jeremy. She's willing to help, but has eyes on Jeremy.Tyler sits guard outside Damon's cellar. Damon asks him what he's still doing in Mystic Fall with his whole family dead. He thinks Tyler is convinced there's still a chance with Caroline.Damon taunts him about Caroline until Tyler comes close enough to bite. Then Damon breaks free and runs.Caroline and Stefan show up. Tyler thinks Damon's after Wes.In Elena's dorm room, Bonnie watches as Liv takes Jeremy's hand to help him find Elena, while also hitting on him. "Does your sister spend a lot of time in church?" Liv asks.In the church, Katherine gets impatient and goes to find Wes.In his makeshift lab, Wes finishes up with the werewolf antidote. He hears a noise and soon Damon is yanking the cell phone out of his hand. As Damon threatens him, Wes reaches for a syringe. But soon, Damon gets impatient and jams his hand into Wes's chest. Damon throws him on a table and goes at his eye with a scalpel.Nadia remembers being in bed with Matt after meeting him while he was with Rebekah in Europe. She tells him about wanting to find Katherine.Katherine shows up at Wes's lab and finds him dead. Her phone rings, it's Stefan calling from Nadia's phone. Stefan won't entertain her attempts to pretend she's Elena. He offers her one last chance to say good-bye to Nadia.Matt brings Nadia a pillow to make her more comfortable. Nadia thinks he's Gregor. "I'm sorry I betrayed you, I did it for my mother, I did everything for her. Forgive me?" she asks.Matt goes along with it. "Yes, I forgive you," he says.Everyone else arrives. Nadia asks Bonnie what will happen when she dies. Bonnie promises she won't feel any pain.Suddenly Katherine walks in the front door and walks straight toward Nadia. "I'm here to see my daughter," she says.Katherine takes Nadia's hand and kneels at her side. Katherine admits Klaus's blood would have saved her if she'd asked, but she would have outed herself. And now it's too late.Nadia starts hallucinating again. "My mother's name is Katherine. She's a liar, and a murderer. She manipulates and betrays, she'll do anything to survive," she says."This is not what your life should have been, searching for a mother who ended up being me," Katherine says.Katherine offers to show her what her life should have been. She shows Nadia a scene of her as a young girl and Katherine tucking her in at night. "Your mother loves you," Katherine says as Nadia dies in front of her.Bonnie sees her spirit on the other side of the room and takes her hand. Katherine covers up her daughter and then turns to face Stefan, Matt, Bonnie, Jeremy, Tyler and Caroline. "So, this is it?" she says.Damon arrives, there's no way she'd miss it. She waits to see who has the knife. Tyler? Because she gave him the werewolf curse and gave him an identity and made him matter. Or Caroline? Who she "made better by making a vampire." Or Matt? When she's the one girl who appreciates him. Or Jeremy? It was nice to have a brother for a second there, when he wasn't being so damn annoying.She turns to face Damon. He points out he's already done this, and said all he needs to say. She, naturally, has something to say. She apologizes for turning him. "I'm sorry that you didn't get to die as a forgotten nobody on a bloody battlefield, that your father didn't get to live another day to be disgraced by you. Damon, I'm sorry that I gave your life passion, purpose, drive, desire. I'm sorry that you are who you are, because I'm the one who taught you how to love," she says."I'll see you in hell, Katherine," Damon says.Finally, Katherine turns to Stefan. She admits she always wondered what it'd be like to be loved by him. "You've got to admit, for a moment, your feelings were real. Stefan, I love you and I've always loved you," she says.Katherine kisses him. And he stabs her. "I guess this is how our love story ends," she says, and crumples to the floor.She slumps against he couch, next to Nadia's desiccated body, her eyes flashing briefly black.Later, Matt sits next to Nadia's dead body. Stefan suggested burying her in the woods, but Matt thinks she deserves better. He picks up her body and carries her out.Stefan and Damon sit next to Elena, waiting for her to wake up. Stefan asks Damon's plan. He's going to tell Elena everything he did and let the chips fall where they may -- he's determined not to be another Katherine and spend his whole life running.Outside, Caroline admits to Tyler that she feels a little bad that Katherine is dead. He throws it back in her face, saying it's because she sees the good in everyone. It's another Klaus dig. She points out that his bite just killed Nadia and no one is batting an eye. She points out she has the same urges as him and it's hard for her to be good. She tells him she's tired of feeling guilty, and it's time for him to get over it.In the church, Bonnie lights a candle for her dad. Katherine's ghost laughs at her. She's there to cross over, but Katherine is bitter. She's tired of Elena always getting what she wants. Wes never had any intention of helping her.Flash to Katherine finding Wes dead. She plays his recorded notes, using Nadia's blood to boost the ripper virus with werewolf virus. She tells Bonnie that she wasn't about to just go easy.Flash to Katherine injecting herself with Wes's virus. She left Elena with a parting gift.Elena, back to her old self, wakes up with Damon and Stefan watching over her. There's another syringe in her pocket.In the church, Katherine pronounces herself ready to go and touches Bonnie. Nothing happens. She tries again. Nothing happens.Katherine gets angry, asking why she can't pass through. Bonnie explains she doesn't control it. Katherine asks who it's up to as Katherine is blown backward off her feet and dragged by an unseen force, out of the church, screaming. Nadia umírá a Katherine v těle Eleny u ní přebývá. Ostatní upíři se Katherine snaží najít, aby ji mohli zabít pomocí poutnického nože. Damon se dokáže osvobodit a následně napadnout Wesleyho, kterého zabije. Upíři zjistí, kde Katherine umírající Nadiu skrývá, a vyrazí tam za ní. Všichni se sejdou nad umírající Nadiou, ani Katherine neuteče, i když ji o to Nadia žádala. Ve chvíli, kdy Nadia zemře a Bonnie ji převede do podsvětí, upíři zabijí Katherine poutnickým nožem.

programme.title: Tijelo je dokaz
programme.desc: Po celonoční taneční party zemře z neznámého důvodu sedmnáctiletý středoškolák Jake Brady. Vyšetřovatelé najdou v jeho kapsách pilulky, které považují za nejpravděpodobnější příčinu smrti. Jenže díky soudní patoložce dr. Megan Huntové (a díky její nové známosti, agentovi FBI Dereku Amesovi) se ukáže, že nejde o drogy a že mladík ani nepožil tolik alkoholu, aby jej to v kombinaci s prášky zabilo. Ve školním internetovém časopise se navíc druhý den objeví fotografie, na které je Jake svázaný a... má na sobě kus kartonu s nápisem "Syn smrti". Podle jeho polohy to vypadá, že jej někdo záměrně nec hal udusit. Jake si totiž ve škole dělal drsnou legraci z některých spolužáků. Z nich se teď tím pádem stanou podezřelí.

Na losangeleskou tísňovou linku volají denně desítky lidí, kteří se ocitli v nouzové situaci. Hasiči, policisté a operátoři musejí nejen pomáhat v těchto nebezpečných momentech, ale zároveň se potýkají s vlastními problémy v soukromí.

programme.title: Chicago u plamenu
programme.desc: Odložený prípad sériového podpaľača sa znovu otvára, keď poručík Severide nájde spojenie s nedávnym požiarom v kaderníctve. Stanica 51 oslavuje odchod jedného hasiča do dôchodku.

programme.title: Chicago u plamenu
programme.desc: Severide a Kiddová pokračujú vo vyšetrovaní Bennyho starého prípadu podpaľačstva, nečakané novinky nútia Brettovú k zváženiu veľkého rozhodnutia a pri výjazde sa rozpútava hotové peklo.

programme.title: Chicago u plamenu
programme.desc: Ničivý požiar v továrni na matrace sa stal osudným pre jedného člena hasičskej jednotky. Úmrtie ťažko dolieha nielen na jeho najbližších, ale aj na Caseyho. Ani po troch mesiacoch nie je prípad uzavretý a na obzore sú disciplinárne postihy. Brettová sa s Kyleom presťahovala do blízkosti svojho rodného mesta a hľadá si prácu. Návrat však nie je taký jednoduchý, ako si predstavovala. Fosterová dostane nového partnera. Podarí sa mu zapadnúť medzi osadenstvo stanice? S kapitánom Matthewom... Caseym, ktorý vedie rotu hasičských áut, a poručíkom Kellym Severideom, ktorý vedie záchrannú jednotku, če lí rodina z hasičskej zbrojnice 51 v tejto sezóne novým nebezpečným výzvam a naďalej nasadzuje vlastné životy, aby udržala ostatných v bezpečí. Keď sme našich hrdinov videli naposledy, predháňali sa v záchrane robotníkov uväznených v horiacej továrni na matrace. Hrozí, že priemyselný kotol každú chvíľu vybuchne, dokážu sa tí najodvážnejší z Chicaga dostať bezpečne von skôr, ako výbuch zlikviduje celý blok.

programme.title: 911: Teksas
programme.desc: Owen Strand, newyorský hasič a veterán z 11. září 2001, se přestěhuje se synem z Manhattanu do Austinu, aby v Texasu vybudoval novou hasičskou stanici a zachraňoval životy místních obyvatel. Owen Strand je hrdinský hasič, který po teroristických útocích z 11. září 2001 musel od základu přebudovat svou hasičskou stanici v New Yorku, protože jako jediný z týmu přežil. Když k podobné tragédii dojde v texaském Austinu, úřady pověří přestavbou zdejší stanice právě jeho. A tak Owen se svým synem T.K. odchází z New Yorku do Texasu, aby zde splnil náročný úkol - vybudoval novou hasičskou stanici a zachraňoval životy místních obyvatel. A vedle toho vyřešil své osobní problémy a znovu... našel životní rovnováhu.

programme.title: Nemogući susret
programme.desc: Politik Matt Damon náhodou potká v den rozhodujících voleb sympatickou Emily Blunt a osudově se do ní zamiluje, aniž by si stihl vzít její adresu nebo telefon. Volby prohraje, ale dívku po nějaké době znovu potká. Věří, že je to láska na celý život, ale z omylu ho vyvedou podivní páni v kloboucích, kteří se mu představí jako správci jeho osudu a sdělí mu, že s ním mají úplně jiné plány. David Norris je stoupající politická hvězda. Nejmladší senátor v historii má reálné šance dostat se do kongresu. Vše však zhatí aféra z jeho studentských let, která se záhadně provalí těsně před volbami. Jde na pánské toalety, kde si chce připravit proslov poraženého. Potká zde krásnou ženu Elise, do které se na první pohled zamiluje. Věří, že to je láska na celý život. Z tohoto omylu ho však vyvedou podivní pánové, kteří se mu představí jako správci jeho osudu a sdělí mu, že s ním mají... úplně jiné plány a že jeho vztah s Elise mezi ně rozhodně nepatří. Tato organizace řídí život každého z nás a pro Davida naplánovala kariéru, která končí možná až v Oválné pracovně Bílého domu. Jenže to by musel nechat Elise na pokoji, což se Davidovi nechce. Pokud se David rozhodne odchýlit se od jejich plánů, budou se správci osudu velice zlobit a udělají všechno pro to, aby se David do jimi nalinkovaných kolejí okamžitě vrátil.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Debra zjistí, že důvodem proč Raymond nechce koupit Frankovo a Mariino staré auta je, že nechce jezdit autem, které už někdo vlastnil.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Raymond se snaží nahradit Debřin zásnubní prsten za správny poté, co zjistí, že je to padělek. Ale proč je Debra tak naštvaná, když se dozví, že Raymond to chce napravit.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Raymond a Debra si užívají hru skrebl s Marií, Frankem, Robertem a poté co dohrají se jdou projít ven.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Debra informuje Raymonda o jeho pesimismu poté, co nemá radost z vítězství "sportovního spisovatele" ceny roku.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Ray našel milého buldoka v sousedství, ale na žádost Debry ho neochotně dává pryč. Nicméně, poté, co už je pryč, přichází právoplaný majitel a žáda ho zpět.

programme.title: Svi vole Raymonda
programme.desc: Raymondovi sousedi mají přijít vyjádřit své četné stížnosti na rodiče Franka a Marie. Raymond cítí pokoření a vinnu ze zrady svých rodičů.

programme.title: Prvi grijeh
programme.desc: Kuba, devatenácté století. Bohatý obchodník Luis Vargas hodlá upevnit své společenské postavení sňatkem s Američankou. Nehledá skutečnou lásku a dohoda je uzavřena čistě na obchodním základě. O to víc je pak překvapen, když mu do života místo prosté ženy vstoupí svůdná Julia. Netrvá dlouho a Vargas se do ní zamiluje. Zanedlouho se objeví i tajemný a podezřívavý Walter Downs, který tvrdí, že Julia není tím, kým se být zdá. Vargas sice zpočátku odmítá uvěřit, ale když manželka zmizí i s jeho... penězi, rozhodne se zjistit, jak se věci doopravdy mají. Vydává se na pouť temnou stránou vášně, kter á jej může zavést až do pekel. Hlavní postavy melodramatického příběhu, který se odehrává na Kubě v osmdesátých letech devatenáctého století, ztvárnily známé herecké hvězdy Angelina Jolieová a Antonio Banderas. Bohatý obchodník s kávou Luis Vargas hodlá upevnit své nejisté společenské postavení sňatkem s Američankou. Nezastírá, že nečeká skutečnou lásku a dohoda bude uzavřena čistě na obchodním základě. Ve svém inzerátu hledá spolehlivou, poslušnou manželku a budoucí matku jeho dětí. O to více je překvapen, když do jeho... života místo obyčejné, nenápadné ženy najednou vstoupí přitažlivá a vyzývavá Julia Russellová, s níž uzavře sňatek. Netrvá dlouho a Vargas se do ní vášnivě zamiluje. Do filmové podoby je převedl již dříve známý francouzský tvůrce François Truffaut pod názvem Siréna od Mississippi.

Když k podobné tragédii dojde v texaském Austinu, úřady pověří přestavbou zdejší stanice právě jeho.
